content: लौल्यम् [लोलस्य भावः ष्यञ्] .²1 Fickleness, unsteadiness, inconstancy. .²2 Eagerness, eager desire, greediness; lustfulness, excessive passion or desire; प्रीतस्तेऽहमलौल्येन भक्त्या तव च सत्तम <ls>Mb. 3. 201. 26</ls>; जिह्वालौल्यात् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; <ls>R. 7. 61</ls>, <ls n="R.">16. 76</ls>, <ls n="R.">18. 31</ls>.
